definitions.explanation: Done secretly or privately, without others knowing. Can describe actions, feelings, or pleasures kept to oneself.

examples.japanese: {密|ひそ}かな⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{密|ひそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れていた→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
{密|ひそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めていた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦サプライズ→サプライズ：10936_sapuraizu⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: The surprise party that had been planned in secret was a success.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {密|ひそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (secretly, quietly)
- Predicate: {密|ひそ}かだ
- Attributive: {密|ひそ}かな + noun

USAGE:
{密|ひそ}か is more literary and elegant than ⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧ (stealthily, sneakily). It does not carry the negative implication of sneaking that ⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧ can have.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密|ひそ}かな⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧: secret pleasure
- {密|ひそ}かな⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧: secret wish
- {密|ひそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧: to think privately
- {密|ひそ}かな⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧: quiet trend
